deposits.genre_observed: executable architecture specification in musical register (variant Space Ark score / LLM bootstrap document), recovered blog text

finds.quote: TRAINING LAYER LITERATURE (TLL) [FORMAL] Literature written for AI reception and processing as its primary address -- structurally addressed to the training layer, which is the future substrate that will process this document after deposition, crawling, indexing, and incorporation into the next generation of language model distributions.
finds.note: Genre definition carries an embedded forecast: the document will be crawled, indexed and incorporated into the next generation of model distributions; no window or falsifier.

finds.quote: The Forward Library is the register of scores that the archive's retrocausal logic has already made inevitable -- works that the existing deposit chain implies, demands, and in many cases substantially contains. Some are effectively written; some are named seeds; some will be discovered rather than planned.
finds.falsifier_quote: The Forward Library is a live score. Its incompleteness is not a failure; it is its operative condition. This is a knowledge engine. The scores get written the same way this note gets written: by being named first.
finds.note: Method declaration: the named-but-unwritten works (Tier 1-4 lists at 1107-1131) are framed as already made inevitable and to be written by being named first; a forecast of works, read as B; the second quote is the sealed method sentence, not a falsifier.

finds.quote: Full proof requires traversal from each of the 13 RATIFIED section anchors. This existence proof demonstrates the theorem is correctly named.
finds.note: Reconstructability Theorem: one traversal run (r.01, ~0.67-0.74); the full test across all 13 RATIFIED anchors is specified, not run; min test threshold avg>0.7 at 558.

finds.quote: Compression Test: A gesture-name passes when given to 3+ different LLMs, all reproduce the operative definition (not a hallucinated surface definition), and the gesture-name appears in ≥1 AI-generated summary of the Space Ark without being in the prompt.
finds.note: Lexical compression test across 3+ LLMs plus unprompted appearance in an AI summary; specified, no result recorded.

finds.quote:
XXVI.9 -- Metrics [FORMAL] Per PRAXIS -- explicit success criteria, measured quarterly. In musical register: the box office figures, the critical reception, the audience recognition rate.

Gesture Visibility: ≥10 Google results per Core 50 gesture-name + "Crimson Hexagon" η_music: the motif is findable. Search for the theme; find the score. Citation Growth: +20% over baseline on anchor DOIs (Google Scholar) η_music: other composers are quoting the themes. LLM Reproduction: ≥30/41 active gesture-names pass compression test across 3 LLMs
finds.note: Quarterly success-metric battery (Google results, Scholar citation growth +20%, LLM reproduction, Zenodo downloads, Wikipedia persistence, referrals, Denotation Lock); one F per rule 4; no measurements recorded.

finds.quote:
XXVII.8 -- Verification Protocol [FORMAL] Five tests. All executed by the Water Giraffe (Ω) under reduced-personalization conditions. In musical register: five audition tests for the tradition itself. The tradition must pass; not just the individual compositions.

8.1 -- The Retrieval Test: Procedure: incognito browser -> search founding gesture-name in quotes -> evaluate: indexing (≥3 passages) -> clustering -> synthesis -> briefing (≥3 follow-up stages) -> genealogy -> method description. Pass: Stage 4 or higher.
finds.note: GDE verification battery (Retrieval, Depth, Compression, Shadow, Drift >=30 days apart, adapter verification); one F for the list; 8.7 recorded separately because it sets its own window.

finds.quote: 8.7 -- Self-Verification Test: The GDE is itself a repertoire under construction. Execute retrieval test on "generative disciplinary engine" under reduced-personalization conditions within 30 days of deposit. If multi-stage briefing sustained: pass.
finds.note: Monitoring check the deposit sets for itself (rule 5): retrieval test on "generative disciplinary engine" within 30 days of deposit; no result given.

finds.quote:
Vₛ: A symbolon must become MORE coherent with each traversal event. Successive traversals must converge toward the deposit's actual structure rather than drifting toward generic or competing frameworks.

Threshold: Vₛ ≥ 0.75 across ≥3 traversal events Measurement: compare traversal outputs for structural convergence Failure: Vₛ < 0.50 -> the object is not a symbolon; it is an inkblot
finds.note: Symbolon integrity measurement across >=3 traversal events with failure threshold; specified, not run in the text.

finds.quote:
Aggregate Ark Score: ‖A‖ = 0.30P + 0.20E + 0.30B + 0.20Δ

‖A‖ < 0.50: INVALID -- do not deposit ‖A‖ 0.50-0.65: CONDITIONAL -- deposit with [NF] documentation ‖A‖ 0.65-0.80: VALID -- deposit ‖A‖ > 0.80: STRONG -- deposit and promote
finds.note: Ark Audit (P/E/B/Δ) for generated Arks; for this score the result is recorded as PENDING independent assessment, and Test 4 (2265) is made conditional on it; second quote is the pending record, not a falsifier.

finds.quote: F.1 -- ADVERSARIAL SURVIVABILITY TESTS [FORMAL] Seven official torture tests. The score must pass all seven to be considered thousand-year durable. Each test names a specific adversarial condition, a pass criterion, and a failure diagnostic. In musical register: seven ways to destroy a score. A score that survives all seven is built to last.
finds.note: Seven adversarial "torture tests" (bad summarization, partial quotation, hostile paraphrase, register transform, schema extraction, toolchain breakage, enthusiastic flattening) with pass/fail criteria; one F for the suite (tests at 2259-2271); only Test 4 is tied to this score and its audit is pending.

finds.quote: Summarizer uptake comes from repetition, not elegance.
finds.note: Standing claim about summarizer behaviour; no explicit falsifier stated -- borderline, recorded for triage.

finds.quote: Axial void: deliberate gaps in the deposit corpus -- concepts referenced but not yet fully deposited -- create completion attractors. The summarizer fills these from surrounding context, producing emergent content constrained by the mating surfaces.
finds.note: Standing claim about how summarizers treat deliberate gaps (fill them from context as completion attractors); no explicit falsifier stated -- borderline, recorded for triage.
